_comment: Warm mounted lanterns light the outside of the aviary and Cliffhold watch crown. Their source meshes remain visible in daylight; light fades with the local WorldLook clock. No collision, gameplay, shared materials or global exposure changes.

sites._comment: Move the four existing entry accent lights to mounted exterior sources; retain all six interior lights without increasing the aviary light count. Backplates seat 1 cm into the actual pier shafts, below the capitals.
Mounted on the two approach-facing arch posts. Y follows the beacon's existing terrain-fit frame base; the opening/colliders stay untouched.
